scope: Independent read-only source review; no helper execution, freeze, installation, HTTP request, Git mutation, or publication performed.
reviewed_assumptions: A fresh source freeze receipt with schema hdblast-source-freeze-v1, matching capsule, source_files/archive_members and manifest/archive records is generated before invocation.
Frozen source inventory and private/internal exclusions are checked by the reviewed freeze/scope tools and later immutable Git inventory gate.
The installer is used once in the specified isolated public worktree, retaining its previous workflow template and all tracked workflow bytes.
Fresh replay is completed and checked before initial evidence installation; the four planning files enumerated here are the reviewed public planning inventory.
Merge recording is observation-only after standard two-parent merge commits and fetch of those immutable objects; any base/head/tree mismatch fails.

resolved_observations.resolution: The exact archive byte buffer whose size and SHA256 are authenticated is now consumed with ZipFile(io.BytesIO(raw)).
Matching receipt/manifest capsule identities and canonical, unique, nonreserved relative manifest paths are enforced before extraction. Source files and every ancestor must not be symlinks.
